name: C# Support & Multi-Language Extension
completionNote: C# support implemented mirroring the Java analyzer pattern. src/languages/csharp-analyzer.js (Roslyn/StyleCop/Sonar diagnostics via dotnet build parse + offline format detector), src/fixers/csharp-fixer.js (offline pattern fixer + dotnet format delegate + engine), docs/CSHARP_SUPPORT.md (research + taxonomy + guide), examples/analyze-csharp.js (offline demo), test/__tests__/csharp.test.js (12 offline tests). P2-T006 (plugin architecture) was already satisfied by src/plugins/plugin-system.js. Full suite: 90 passing / 0 failing.

completed.name: Research C# analyzers
completed.statusNote: Research summarized in docs/CSHARP_SUPPORT.md (P2-T001 table): Roslyn/StyleCop/Sonar all deliver diagnostics through the compiler, so one `dotnet build` parse captures all three; dotnet format handles style. Analyzer degrades gracefully offline.

completed.name: Implement Roslyn analyzer integration
completed.description: Build CLI integration for .NET compiler platform analyzers
completed.statusNote: Implemented in src/languages/csharp-analyzer.js (CSharpAnalyzer): analyzeFile/analyzeProject via `dotnet build`, parseBuildOutput() normalizes MSBuild diagnostics (SA/CA/IDE/S/CS) with dedupe, checkTools(), findFiles()/matchPattern(). Parses diagnostics even from failed builds. Verified by tests + examples/analyze-csharp.js.

completed.name: Extend issue taxonomy for C#
completed.description: Add C#-specific issue types, patterns, and best practices
completed.statusNote: Taxonomy in docs/CSHARP_SUPPORT.md (P2-T003) + codified in csharp-analyzer.js categorizeRule()/isRuleFixable()/mapRoslynSeverity(): SA->STYLE, CA->CODE_ANALYSIS, IDE->STYLE, S<n>->SONAR, CS->COMPILER; fixable set = SA1xxx/IDE formatting rules.

completed.name: Implement C# auto-fix rules
completed.description: Create C#-specific fix templates and AST manipulation
completed.statusNote: Implemented in src/fixers/csharp-fixer.js: CSharpPatternFixer (offline transforms CRLF->LF, tabs->spaces, trailing whitespace, final newline; dryRun + backup/rollback), DotnetFormatFixer (dotnet format delegate with --verify-no-changes for dry-run), CSharpFixEngine coordinator. Verified real fix, dry-run, and rollback in tests.

completed.name: Add C# examples and documentation
completed.description: Create C# usage examples and integration guide
completed.statusNote: docs/CSHARP_SUPPORT.md (integration guide covering all P2 tasks) + examples/analyze-csharp.js (offline end-to-end demo: parse diagnostics -> detect -> fix -> print). Example run verified.

completed.name: Create language plugin architecture
completed.description: Design extensible plugin system for additional language support
completed.statusNote: Already provided by src/plugins/plugin-system.js (PluginManager + Plugin base): sandboxed loading, manifest validation, hook + custom-rule registration, load/unload/reload lifecycle. New languages register analyzers/rules through this API; C# support serves as the reference language implementation. Documented in docs/CSHARP_SUPPORT.md (P2-T006).

completed.name: C# integration testing
completed.description: Build test suite for C# analysis and fixes
completed.statusNote: test/__tests__/csharp.test.js: 12 offline, deterministic tests (severity mapping, rule categorization, build-output parse + dedupe, offline format detection, file discovery, auto-fix dry-run/real/rollback/multi-file stats). Suite total 90 passing / 0 failing via `npm test`.
